name: Wednesday Night WarFair

matches.note: Goldstein's own manager, Stan Vickers, bribed Travis with a briefcase of cash to walk out and take the countout.
Commissioner Gabe Knox interfered with a chair shot against Shadow, a personal rival, letting Swamp Thing finish with a crossface hold.

no_appearances_reason: The broadcast previews a Royal Rumble to crown the promotion's first Heavyweight Champion at a 25 April 1999 supercard, not yet held on any document in the held record.

evidence.source: The promotion's own weekly broadcast, now served in full.
evidence.note: Two matches; a supercard (Lord of the Rings) announced for 25 April 1999 to crown the first Heavyweight Champion.

notes: The promotion's own second directly-attested weekly broadcast; a companion posting the following week recaps a prior Ah'riman-vs-Cherokee barbwire match and a Shadow-Swamp Thing rematch, collected but not merged into this page given a conflicting internal chronology between the two postings.
